Use this topic index to move between concepts, supported behavior, and detailed
contracts. The linked pages remain the source for their respective definitions.

## Complete goal tutorials {#goal-tutorials}

Choose a complete reader workflow by calculation goal:

| Calculation goal | Tutorial |
| --- | --- |
| Terminal capacitance | [Extract a pad capacitance](tutorials/capacitance.qmd) |
| Resonant mode | [Find a resonant mode](tutorials/resonance.qmd) |
| Mode energy participation | [Read mode energy participation](tutorials/resonance-epr.qmd) |
| Driven CPW scattering response | [Extract a CPW scattering response](tutorials/scattering.qmd) |
| CPW per-unit-length RLGC | [Extract CPW transmission-line parameters](tutorials/transmission-line.qmd) |

## Model and materials {#model-materials}

Start with the [physical problem](concepts/problems.qmd) and
[model assumptions](concepts/model-and-numerics.qmd#define-the-physical-model).
The [physical representation contract](specs/physical-representation.qmd#typed-source-carrier-and-plan)
describes how source declarations reach backend preparation.

## Conductors and ports {#conductors-ports}

Read [Entities, occurrences, and Nets](concepts/geometry.qmd#entity-occurrence-and-net)
with the [driven-response concept](concepts/problems.qmd#driven-response-excite-a-port-at-a-frequency).
The [model preparation tutorial](course/working-model.qmd) shows how those
choices enter a selected case; the [CPW scattering tutorial](tutorials/scattering.qmd#configure-port-models)
compares its Modal and Wave Terminal declarations.

## Mesh and adaptation {#mesh-adaptation}

The [mesh diagnostic contract](mesh-quality.qmd#input-and-ownership) defines
what the stored-mesh reader measures. The [prepared-backend tutorial](course/solver-observations.qmd)
shows where to inspect the mesh and native preparation before execution.

## Execution and handoff {#execution-handoff}

Use the [execution profile contract](execution-profiles.qmd#handoff-lifecycle)
for portable handoffs and caller-controlled solver runs, then follow the
[handoff tutorial](course/execute.qmd).

## Results and reports {#results-reports}

The [report contract](report-model.qmd#common-envelope) describes result
identity, availability, and presentation. The
[returned-results tutorial](course/returned-results.qmd#interpret-for-scq-use)
shows how to read a completed package for a selected use.

## Saved fields and offline loss {#saved-fields-offline-loss}

Use the [saved-field tutorial](course/aedt-saved-fields.qmd#recover-the-exact-prepared-model)
for native field evaluation and the [offline EPR tutorial](course/offline-epr.qmd#interpret-an-assumption-change)
for assumption changes on recorded results.
